instruction: Design a ERP architecture. using a Microservices style. deployed on GCP. satisfying: Observability Stack, Rate Limiting.

threats.name: SQL Injection
threats.description: Attackers can execute malicious SQL statements that control a web application's database server.

threats.name: DDoS
threats.description: Distributed Denial of Service attacking service availability.

threats.name: Lateral Movement
threats.description: Attackers move through the network searching for key assets.

threats.name: Unauthorized Access
threats.description: Attackers can access systems or data without proper identity verification.

threats.name: Credential Stuffing
threats.description: Automated injection of breached username/password pairs.

threats.name: Privilege Escalation
threats.description: Users or attackers can gain higher access rights than they are supposed to have.

threats.name: Insider Threat
threats.description: Malicious or negligent actions by internal users.

threats.name: Session Hijacking
threats.description: Attackers take over an active user session.

recommendations: Add Authentication service to protect user access.
Add API Gateway to secure and manage external traffic.
security.security_summary: Architecture contains a frontend and an API service but lacks WAF, Monitoring, Authentication, RBAC and API Gateway. Overall security posture is HIGH RISK and requires immediate remediation.
